model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram is a donut chart that compares the proportions of different categories of characters, with a total of nine distinct sectors. The central, largest segment is labeled "Virtual Characters" and is colored light blue, representing the most prominent category. Surrounding this central segment are eight outer segments, each labeled with a specific character type: "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," all of which are colored in various shades of light blue and are positioned around the upper and left portions of the chart. On the right side, a separate cluster of five smaller segments represents "Real Characters," each in a different shade of green, with labels for "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers." A smaller, distinct segment labeled "Custom Characters" is colored pink and is positioned between the "Virtual Characters" and the "Real Characters" cluster. The chart includes a legend with labels and corresponding colors for each category, and the labels are placed outside the chart with lines pointing to their respective segments. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise order around the central "Virtual Characters" section.
model_annotations.English: This donut chart illustrates the distribution of character types across different categories, with a central focus on the distinction between virtual and real characters. The chart is divided into two main sections: the outer ring represents various types of characters, while the inner circle is split into two large segments labeled "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters." The outer ring includes categories such as Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, all of which are grouped under the "Virtual Characters" category, indicated by the light blue color. The "Real Characters" category, shown in green, includes subcategories like Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers. The chart uses a color-coded system, with the outer ring segments in light blue and the inner circle segments in blue and green, to visually differentiate the categories. The labels are clearly positioned around the chart, and the relative sizes of the segments suggest that the "Virtual Characters" category encompasses a broader range of types compared to "Real Characters."
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt eine visuelle Klassifizierung von Charaktertypen in einem mehrschichtigen Kreisdiagramm, das die Beziehungen zwischen verschiedenen Kategorien darstellt. Im Zentrum befindet sich der Bereich „Real Characters“, der in einem hellgrünen Farbton dargestellt ist und von einem größeren blauen Ring umgeben ist, der „Virtual Characters“ repräsentiert. Um diesen blauen Ring herum sind acht weitere Segmente angeordnet, die jeweils einen Charaktertyp darstellen: „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“, „Game Characters“, „Custom Characters“, „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ und „Influencers“. Die Segmente sind in unterschiedlichen Blautönen und einem hellrosa für „Custom Characters“ gehalten, wobei die Farben zur Unterscheidung der Kategorien dienen. Die Segmente sind im Uhrzeigersinn angeordnet, beginnend mit „Comic Characters“ und endend mit „Influencers“. Es sind keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente oder in einer Legende sichtbar, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Vergrößerungen oder Versetzungen der Segmente.
